event.description: Use block-diagonal per-head value maps with full retained query-key maps
event.proposal: Family: attention organization. Current retained frontier is 1,672 parameters at 99.010000%, a +0.010000 percentage-point margin over 99%. There have been 7 prior attempts in this family. The most recent accepted result is attempt-0020, which removed attention output projections and qualified at 3,168 parameters and 99.94%; the most recent failed result is attempt-0100, whose head-specific-symmetric/shared-skew QK decomposition scored 0.13% at 1,601 parameters. Attempts 0097-0100 collectively close direct Q/K bilinear compression. Hypothesis: each value head primarily reads its corresponding eight-dimensional residual subspace, so cross-half value weights are redundant even though full retained Q/K geometry is necessary. This major attention-organization change preserves the reconstructed 32x16 Q/K maps exactly, replaces the 16x16 value map with two learned 8x8 diagonal blocks migrated from the checkpoint, and yields 1,593 parameters. It is more informative than a diagonal value map because it retains all within-head mixing while isolating whether cross-head residual input mixing is needed. Generic two-head causal softmax self-attention and autoregressive decoding remain intact.
